entities.summary: American teaching hospital (est. 1889) that revolutionized medical education and practice by combining research, teaching, and clinical care. Under William Osler, William Halsted, and others, Johns Hopkins introduced bedside teaching, residency training, and evidence-based medicine that became the global standard for academic medicine.
